action.query: Medi-Cal official California Department of Health Care Services eligibility apply 2026
queries: Medi-Cal official California Department of Health Care Services eligibility apply 2026

content.text:
Do you mean **Medi-Cal in California**—for example how to apply, eligibility, renewal, or coverage?

Quick overview:

- **Medi-Cal** is California’s Medicaid program, offering free or low-cost health coverage for eligible Californians. ([ca.gov](https://www.ca.gov/departments/217/services/37/?utm_source=openai))
- You can apply:
  - Online through **Covered California**
  - By contacting your **county social services office**
  - By mail using a Medi-Cal application
  - With help from Covered California at **1-800-300-1506** ([dhcs.ca.gov](https://www.dhcs.ca.gov/medi-cal/apply/?utm_source=openai))
- Medi-Cal generally covers doctor visits, hospital care, emergency care, prescriptions, mental health care, pregnancy care, and many preventive services.
- As of **January 1, 2026**, California has a freeze on **new enrollments for certain adults who are undocumented and do not have satisfactory immigration status for federal full-scope Medi-Cal**. Existing eligibility can depend on your situation, so it’s best to apply or check with the county. ([ca.gov](https://www.ca.gov/departments/217/services/37/?utm_source=openai))

If you tell me what you need—**apply**, **check eligibility**, **renew**, **find a doctor**, **report income**, or **fix a denial**—I can guide you step by step.
